nuggets.text: The Lakers are on back-to-back trips to New Mexico, playing New Mexico State last week and the Lobos on Saturday.
The Lakers' game at New Mexico State last week was their first against an FBS opponent in the Division I era.
Thomas Sydeski was 31 when the Lakers named him head coach, one of the youngest head coaches in college football.
The Lakers' homecoming next week doubles as Mercyhurst's 100th anniversary celebration.
The Lakers' mascot is Luke the Laker.
The Lakers face three FBS opponents this season: New Mexico State, New Mexico and Western Kentucky.
Saturday is the first meeting ever between the Lakers and the Lobos.
Teddy McDuffie Jr. made 1.5 sacks against Youngstown State and was named an NEC Prime Performer.
The Lakers moved up to Division I FCS in 2024 after playing in Division II from 1993 through 2023.
The Lakers' only conference title came in 2010, when they won the PSAC as a Division II program.
